The entire leaf is uniformly brown and dried out — no green tissue remains, no spots, no white powder, no black sooty coating. This pattern suggests dieback (tip/branch dieback causing complete leaf desiccation and browning).

Now let me view one reference image from Die_Back to confirm.

The Die_Back reference is a near-perfect match: same uniform brown coloration, same desiccated/shriveled texture, same curled/twisted form with no spots, powder, or sooty coating. The test image matches Die_Back very closely.
